nodes.label: Companies List View — Vantage CRM
nodes.description: CRM Companies page showing a table of 7 companies with columns: Company, Industry, Location, Employees, Website. Active sidebar shows CRM (Pipeline selected), Infrastructure, General sections. Alert bar visible at top showing 3 active alerts (1 critical, 2 warning, 0 info) for prod-worker-01 memory 91.7%. Topbar has Search, notification bell, and +Add Company button. User shown as Nina Park (Admin).
navigation_sections: CRM: Pipeline, Contacts, Companies, Tasks, Activity, Mail

nodes.label: Infra Alert Bar Component
nodes.description: Persistent alert bar shown at the top of CRM pages showing active infrastructure alerts. Displays 3 active alerts with highest severity message 'prod-worker-01 memory 91.7%'. Expandable with severity breakdown: CRITICAL(1), WARNING(2), INFO(0). Has Open link and dismiss (X) button.

nodes.label: Sidebar Navigation Component — Vantage
nodes.description: Left sidebar navigation 220px wide. Logo top-left. Sections: CRM (Pipeline active with dark fill, Contacts, Companies, Tasks, Activity, Mail), Infrastructure (Servers, Databases, Websites, Files), General (Analytics, Alerts with red dot badge, Settings). Bottom: user avatar + name + role + logout icon.

nodes.label: Vantage Brand / Product Identity
nodes.description: The product displayed in these screenshots is branded as 'Vantage' (later rebranded to Vencore). The logo is a geometric/angular mark with 'Vantage' wordmark in the sidebar. White-label platform for company management covering CRM and infrastructure monitoring.
